trigger_or_condition: Acceptance event is received from the diagnostic provider
notes: ContinuumOS records the event; it does not itself accept the order. Uncertain patient or encounter linkage must first route to reconciliation.

trigger_or_condition: Appointment or diagnostic slot is recorded
notes: Rescheduling or cancellation is handled as operational work and remains auditable.

trigger_or_condition: Diagnostic event completion is received
notes: Completion does not mean a result is available.

trigger_or_condition: For the approved synthetic fixture: accepted current DiagnosticReport status is final amended or corrected; the current source version is recorded; configured required result references resolve; and separate source-specific completion evidence is present
notes: Observation or preliminary/partial evidence alone is insufficient; this is a fixture rule rather than a universal FHIR requirement, and missing or inconsistent configured evidence routes to Result Incomplete.

trigger_or_condition: Acknowledgement work item is assigned and active
notes: The system applies owner and SLA rules; it does not make a clinical judgement.

trigger_or_condition: Clinician reviews current report version and explicitly acknowledges it
notes: AI summary cannot substitute for source-report review or acknowledgement.

trigger_or_condition: Follow-up decision task is opened
notes: A later amended report can reopen Clinical Review Pending.

trigger_or_condition: Clinician approves clinic management and pathway-specific next-step evidence is present
accountable_owner: Clinic physician for decision; Care Coordinator for closure verification
notes: The physician chooses clinic management; the Care Coordinator verifies the named clinic owner, follow-up timeframe, required task and required communication or explicit confirmation evidence. Sent or delivered alone does not prove understanding or acceptance.

trigger_or_condition: Clinician approves referral or hospital escalation
notes: The physician is accountable for the clinical direction; the Referral Coordinator prepares and routes the approved referral task.

trigger_or_condition: Receiving team accepts required referral or escalation handoff
notes: The receiving team accepts or rejects the handoff; the Referral Coordinator records the response and coordinates downstream work.

trigger_or_condition: Path has no financial-readiness requirement and all pathway-specific next-step evidence is present
notes: The Care Coordinator verifies named destination, timeframe, receiving response and required communication or explicit confirmation evidence; the system only marks the state. Sent or delivered alone does not prove understanding or acceptance.

trigger_or_condition: Urgent human-approved hospital escalation has clinical direction, receiving-team handoff, accountable owner, timeframe and required patient communication or confirmation evidence recorded
notes: Financial Readiness Pending remains visible and unresolved as a separately owned dependency; it does not block urgent clinical progression. The Care Coordinator verifies pathway-specific evidence before the system records the state.

trigger_or_condition: Selected planned path requires administrative readiness after clinical and referral prerequisites
notes: The Billing/pre-authorisation user prepares
column9: submits and tracks readiness work. This state represents supporting work and does not authorise care.

trigger_or_condition: Authorised financial decision-maker records final financial authorisation and all planned-path closure conditions are complete
notes: The Billing/pre-authorisation user prepares
column9: submits and tracks the readiness work; the Authorised financial decision-maker records the final decision; the Care Coordinator verifies pathway closure conditions before the system marks the episode confirmed.

trigger_or_condition: Human disposition is recorded; required handoff is complete or not applicable; next-step owner and receiving response are recorded where required; required communication or explicit confirmation evidence is recorded; no safety-blocking exception remains; and source/workflow references are complete
notes: The Care Coordinator performs the human-owned closure action with actor and timestamp. A deterministic rule may test completeness but cannot close the workflow. Audit corrections create linked entries rather than overwriting history.

trigger_or_condition: Patient cannot be matched under defined rules
notes: Do not attach the event; return only after human match confirmation.

trigger_or_condition: Required encounter cannot be confirmed
notes: Hold progression until encounter reconciliation is complete.

trigger_or_condition: Repeated order completion or result event is suspected
notes: Preserve all events and resolve through human review before returning to the appropriate state.

trigger_or_condition: For the approved synthetic fixture, accepted report status/version, configured referenced result evidence or separate source-specific completion evidence is missing or inconsistent
notes: Observation or preliminary/partial evidence alone cannot establish Result Available. Return only when the current report and configured fixture evidence satisfy T04.

from_state: Result Available or Clinical Review Pending or Result Acknowledged
trigger_or_condition: New amended or corrected report version is received
notes: Preserve all versions and prior acknowledgement history. Do not carry a prior acknowledgement forward as valid for the amended/corrected version; flag downstream referral or patient communication based on the older version for human reassessment.

trigger_or_condition: Amended or corrected report version is routed for renewed review
notes: A new clinician acknowledgement is required for the current amended/corrected version. If a prior acknowledgement existed, it remains historical evidence only; affected follow-up direction, referral and patient communication require human reassessment before further reliance.

from_state: Clinical Review Pending or Follow-up Decision Required
trigger_or_condition: Assigned clinician cannot act within the defined operating policy
notes: The authorised clinical escalation owner assigns approved coverage; the new clinician independently reviews source evidence. The Care Coordinator tracks the workflow.

trigger_or_condition: Receiving team rejects the referral or requests a materially different route
notes: The receiving team records the rejection; the Referral Coordinator tracks it and the responsible clinician records any new direction. Do not redirect automatically.

trigger_or_condition: Responsible clinician selects an alternative care direction
notes: A new referral may be created only after a new human decision.

trigger_or_condition: Required administrative information is absent
notes: Remain blocked in Financial Readiness Pending until the missing information is reconciled.

trigger_or_condition: Selected administrative route is denied
notes: The Authorised financial decision-maker records the administrative denial; the Billing/pre-authorisation user records the submission and response evidence. Route to a human-controlled alternative decision; submission or denial is not a confirmed next step.

trigger_or_condition: Responsible clinician records an alternative clinical direction
notes: Do not automatically select a clinical or administrative alternative. Any separate administrative option remains subject to the Authorised financial decision-maker.

trigger_or_condition: Required source system or simulated interface is unavailable
human_control_required: Yes for reconciliation and safe return
notes: Entering the exception can be automatic; use approved manual reconciliation and return only after source data is verified.
